title: Eighty experiments on the Voynich manuscript: code, results and bilingual site
description: Eighty statistical experiments on the text of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), each run on natural-language and enciphered controls before the manuscript. Includes the experiment scripts, the numerical results as JSON, the figures, and the bilingual (English, Portuguese) explanatory site. Main result: the text is statistically indistinguishable from a three-rule process (two-glyph habit, 4% local copying, page-by-page bias), with no lexicon above the habit and no page-specific vocabulary; the labels next to the drawings are the one exception; a Naibbe-class verbose homophonic cipher (Greshko 2025) remains an open hypothesis because the solvers built here could not break Greshko's own control.
